must_have: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field

5+ years of software engineering experience in a SaaS product company; and 2+ years of hands-on experience developing or operating SaaS applications in a public cloud environment such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Programming experience in one or more languages such as Java, Python, or Go and experience designing and implementing REST APIs and backend services
Hands-on experience with containers and orchestration platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes, or AWS EKS and experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems
Experience with networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, load balancing, and network security concepts
Experience debugging and problem-solving skills across application, infrastructure, and cloud service layers
Experience with Generative AI, including large language models, prompt engineering, AI-assisted development workflows, and responsible use of AI in software engineering
preferred: Experience with observability platforms and tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry, Kibana, OpenSearch, or similar technologies
Experience building or operating telemetry, monitoring, alerting, and service health management systems
Experience with distributed data stores or analytics platforms such as OpenSearch, ClickHouse, or Elasticsearch
Experience with cloud security, identity, access control, RBAC, and multi-tenant SaaS security models
Familiarity with cybersecurity, networking, zero trust, or IoT security solutions

requirements_summary: Cisco is a technology company developing secure, cloud-native solutions for connectivity, cybersecurity, identity management, and digital infrastructure. The Cloud Engineer will design, develop, deploy, and operate scalable SaaS applications and distributed services in public cloud environments while improving automation, observability, reliability, and security. responsibilities: Design, develop, test, deploy, and support cloud-native SaaS applications and services
Build scalable, resilient, and secure distributed systems using microservices architecture
Develop and operate services running in public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Participate in the design and implementation of service automation, monitoring, observability, and telemetry pipelines
Analyze service health, performance metrics, logs, traces, and alerts to improve reliability and customer experience
Own services through the full lifecycle, from design and implementation to production support and continuous improvement
Work on deployment, configuration, and operational readiness for SaaS services in production environments
Review architecture, designs, implementation plans, test strategies, and operational procedures
Troubleshoot complex production and customer issues across application, infrastructure, database, and networking layers
Collaborate with engineering, product management, security, SRE, DevOps, and customer-facing teams
Contribute to building secure, scalable, and reliable business solutions for Cisco customers and partners
